args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List

Based on Emma Johnson's Hawaii Vacation Plans (June 10-20, 2024)

Essential Documents:
- Passport/ID
- Travel insurance documents
- Hotel reservations
- Car rental confirmation (if needed)
- Emergency contact information
- Credit cards and cash
- Travel adapter

Clothing:
- Swimwear (multiple sets)
- Beach cover-ups
- Light, breathable t-shirts
- Shorts and casual pants
- Sundresses
- Light jacket or sweater (for air conditioning)
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Sandals
- Hiking boots (for Diamond Head)
- Underwear and socks
- Pajamas

Beach & Water Activities:
- Sunscreen (SPF 30+)
- Sunglasses
- Beach towel
- Beach bag
- Snorkeling gear (if not provided)
- Water shoes
- Hat or cap
- Beach umbrella or canopy

Hiking & Outdoor Activities:
- Hiking boots
- Moisture-wicking socks
- Trekking poles
- Lightweight rain jacket
- Bug spray
- First aid kit
- Hand sanitizer

Technology:
- Camera and extra batteries
- Phone and charger
- Portable power bank
- Waterproof phone case
- Headphones

Health & Personal Care:
- Prescription medications
- Over-the-counter medications (pain reliever, allergy meds)
- Deodorant
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Shampoo and conditioner
- Body wash
- Hairbrush/comb
- Hair ties
- Makeup (if desired)
- Sunscreen (multiple bottles)
- Lip balm with SPF

Miscellaneous:
- Beach games (frisbee, volleyball)
- Book or e-reader
- Journal and pen
- Hand sanitizer
- Wet wipes
- Plastic bags for wet items
- Reusable water bottle
- Snacks for the day
- Cash for tips and small purchases
